title: HomeFlood Early-Renewal Credit
content:
**Rule.** A HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies renewal term premium carries an early-renewal credit when the coming term's first payment arrives ahead of the coming term start. The payment looked at is the latest payment received for the coming term as its installment 1. The days are counted in calendar days from the date that payment was received to the coming term start.

| First payment of the coming term received | Early-renewal credit |
|---|---|
| at least 30 days before the coming term start | 3 percent |
| at least 8 but fewer than 30 days before | 1.5 percent |
| fewer than 8 days before, or no such payment on record | none |

**Form of the credit.** The credit is a percent of the premium the renewal term premium starts from, and it is subtracted from that premium.

## Boundary cases

| Days before the coming term start | Credit |
|---|---|
| 30 | 3 percent |
| 29 | 1.5 percent |
| 8 | 1.5 percent |
| 7 | none |

*Hypothetical illustration:* a coming term starting on 1 July, with installment 1 received on 1 June, is 30 days ahead and earns 3 percent.
